propositions: rebar hardcodes comment truncation at 32767 characters via WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT, but Jira Data Center's admin-configurable jira.text.field.character.limit can be raised to 2147483647 or set to 0 (unlimited), causing silent data loss when comments exceed the hardcoded ceiling but fit within the admin-configured one

the stock default of 32767 for jira.text.field.character.limit is correct per JRASERVER-28519 and applies to Jira 7.0+, but instances with raised limits silently truncate valid comments without author notification

sanitize_comment couples to the description fitter fit_outbound via WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT, creating a latent trap where future changes to description fitting would silently retarget comment truncation

the DC comment ceiling must be configurable via [tool.rebar.reconciler].comment_max_chars with default 32767, range 0–2147483647, and must not share the description fitter function to prevent convergence failure between sanitize_comment and fit_comment transforms

endpoint /rest/api/2/application-properties/advanced-settings is admin-only and not readable by rebar's non-admin PAT, so live auto-discovery of the instance ceiling is not viable and configuration is the only remedy
